cc:Work.dc:title: Issue 473 Mendelian variant-effect trajectories
cc:Work.dc:description: Eight panels show full-window and center-1 AUPRC and Group SMD trajectories for CDS missense, splicing, and synonymous variants and enhancer distal variants on the development split.
